title: CLI commands that don't talk to PostHog must be exempted from init_context credentials
answers: New posthog-cli command fails without a token
How to add a posthog-cli subcommand that needs no credentials
Where is the CLI command list exempt from init_context?
body:
Adding a `Commands` variant in `cli/src/commands.rs` touches several places together:
- the enum variant itself
- `telemetry_command_name` match arm
- the dispatch match (calls e.g. `crate::update::update()`)
- `pub mod` in `cli/src/lib.rs`
- if the command never contacts PostHog, add it to the `matches!` exemption list beside `Login` and `Api` in `Cli`, or `init_context` runs and errors without a token (review caught this for `Update`).
Also add a `cli/.sampo/changesets/*.md` entry (`cargo/posthog-cli: patch`) and document user-facing commands in `cli/README.md`.
